ELESIS-ELESIS_STRIKE.title: Strike
ELESIS-ELESIS_DEFEND.title: Defend
ELESIS-COUNTER_GUARD.title: Counter Guard
ELESIS-BURNING_EDGE.title: Burning Edge
ELESIS-MEASURED_SLASH.title: Measured Slash
ELESIS-MEASURED_SLASH.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target intends to attack, gain {CounterAttackPower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue].
ELESIS-EMBER_THRUST.title: Ember Thrust
ELESIS-SCORCHING_FEINT.title: Scorching Feint
ELESIS-SCORCHING_FEINT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target has [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color], gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
ELESIS-GUARDED_CUT.title: Guarded Cut
ELESIS-GUARDED_CUT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold], plus {BonusBlock:diff()} if you have [blue]Counter Attack[/blue].
ELESIS-KINDLED_SWEEP.title: Kindled Sweep
ELESIS-KINDLED_SWEEP.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Apply {BurnPower:diff()} [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] to ALL enemies.
ELESIS-ANSWERING_BLOW.title: Answering Blow
ELESIS-ANSWERING_BLOW.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you have [blue]Counter Attack[/blue], draw {Cards:diff()} card.
ELESIS-COALBRAND.title: Coalbrand
ELESIS-COALBRAND.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target has no [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color], apply {BurnPower:diff()} [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color].
ELESIS-OPENING_READ.title: Opening Read
ELESIS-OPENING_READ.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target intends to attack, gain {CounterAttackPower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue]; otherwise apply {BurnPower:diff()} [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color].
ELESIS-SEARING_POMMEL.title: Searing Pommel
ELESIS-SEARING_POMMEL.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target has [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color], draw {Cards:diff()} card.
ELESIS-CROSSFIRE_SLASH.title: Crossfire Slash
ELESIS-CHALLENGE_SWEEP.title: Challenge Sweep
ELESIS-CHALLENGE_SWEEP.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Gain {CounterAttackPower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue].
ELESIS-READY_GUARD.title: Ready Guard
ELESIS-HEAT_HAZE.title: Heat Haze
ELESIS-LOW_GUARD.title: Low Guard
ELESIS-LOW_GUARD.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. If an enemy intends to attack, gain {CounterAttackPower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue].
ELESIS-ASHEN_VEIL.title: Ashen Veil
ELESIS-ASHEN_VEIL.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold], plus {BonusBlock:diff()} if any enemy has [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color].
ELESIS-RED_CHALLENGE.title: Red Challenge
ELESIS-BANKED_SPARK.title: Banked Spark
ELESIS-STEADY_BREATH.title: Steady Breath
ELESIS-COVERING_EMBERS.title: Covering Embers
ELESIS-ROOTED_DEFENSE.title: Rooted Defense
ELESIS-REPRISAL_CUT.title: Reprisal Cut
ELESIS-REPRISAL_CUT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Your next [blue]Counter Attack[/blue] trigger before your next turn deals {ReprisalCutPower:diff()} additional damage.
ELESIS-BURNING_REVERSAL.title: Burning Reversal
ELESIS-BURNING_REVERSAL.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target has [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color], gain {CounterAttackPower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue].
ELESIS-CINDER_BARRAGE.title: Cinder Barrage
ELESIS-CINDER_BARRAGE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Hits} times. Apply {BurnPower} [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] after each hit.
ELESIS-PRESSURE_BREAK.title: Pressure Break
ELESIS-PRESSURE_BREAK.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you have [blue]Counter Attack[/blue], apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [red]Vulnerable[/red].
ELESIS-FLASHPOINT.title: Flashpoint
ELESIS-FLASHPOINT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, then deal damage equal to half the target's [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] without reducing it.
ELESIS-BACKSTEP_CLEAVE.title: Backstep Cleave
ELESIS-BACKSTEP_CLEAVE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. If any enemy intends to attack, gain {CounterAttackPower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue].
ELESIS-TEMPERED_EDGE.title: Tempered Edge
ELESIS-TEMPERED_EDGE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, plus 1 for every {BurnDivisor:diff()} [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] on the target.
ELESIS-PROVOKED_ASSAULT.title: Provoked Assault
ELESIS-PROVOKED_ASSAULT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain {CounterPerHit:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue] per hit in the target's intent, up to {CounterCap:diff()}.
ELESIS-CHARRED_WOUND.title: Charred Wound
ELESIS-CHARRED_WOUND.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] equal to half the target's current Burn, up to {BurnCap:diff()}.
ELESIS-TWIN_VERDICT.title: Twin Verdict
ELESIS-TWIN_VERDICT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage twice. Apply {BurnPower:diff()} [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] after the first hit and gain {CounterAttackPower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue] after the second.
ELESIS-LAYERED_DEFENSE.title: Layered Defense
ELESIS-LAYERED_DEFENSE.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and {CounterAttackPower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue], plus {PerEnemy:diff()} of each per enemy intending to attack.
ELESIS-COUNTERMEASURE.title: Countermeasure
ELESIS-COUNTERMEASURE.description: Gain {CounterAttackPower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue]. If you already had Counter Attack, draw {Cards} card.
ELESIS-SHELTER_IN_SPARKS.title: Shelter in Sparks
ELESIS-SHELTER_IN_SPARKS.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. If any enemy has [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color], gain {CounterAttackPower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue].
ELESIS-FAN_THE_ASHES.title: Fan the Ashes
ELESIS-FAN_THE_ASHES.description: Apply {BurnPower:diff()} [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] to ALL enemies. Their next Burn decay loses {BurnStabilizerPower:diff()} fewer charges, minimum 1.
ELESIS-TRANSFER_HEAT.title: Transfer Heat
ELESIS-TRANSFER_HEAT.description: Remove up to {BurnCap:diff()} [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] from an enemy. Gain that much [blue]Counter Attack[/blue].
ELESIS-REDIRECTION.title: Redirection
ELESIS-REDIRECTION.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. The next enemy attack before your next turn applies {RedirectionPower:diff()} [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] to its attacker.
ELESIS-CALCULATED_RISK.title: Calculated Risk
ELESIS-CINDER_SCREEN.title: Cinder Screen
ELESIS-CINDER_SCREEN.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold], plus {BlockPerEnemy:diff()} for each enemy with [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color].
ELESIS-BURNING_PATIENCE.title: Burning Patience
ELESIS-STEEL_NERVES.title: Steel Nerves
ELESIS-STEEL_NERVES.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. If no enemy intends to attack, apply {BurnPower:diff()} [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] to ALL enemies.
ELESIS-ECHO_GUARD.title: Echo Guard
ELESIS-ECHO_GUARD.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and {CounterAttackPower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue]. The next {DoubleCounterPower:diff()} attack hits before your next turn trigger Counter Attack twice.
ELESIS-ASH_RECLAMATION.title: Ash Reclamation
ELESIS-ASH_RECLAMATION.description: Remove all [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] from an enemy. Draw 1 card per {BurnPerCard:diff()} Burn removed, up to {Cards:diff()}.
ELESIS-SHARED_THREAT.title: Shared Threat
ELESIS-SHARED_THREAT.description: Gain [blue]Counter Attack[/blue] equal to an enemy's [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color], up to {CounterAttackPower:diff()}.
ELESIS-WATCH_THE_BLADE.title: Watch the Blade
ELESIS-WATCH_THE_BLADE.description: Draw {Cards} cards. If any enemy intends to attack, gain {CounterAttackPower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue].
ELESIS-SMOLDERING_GUARD.title: Smoldering Guard
ELESIS-SMOLDERING_GUARD.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. The next attack that breaks your Block before your next turn applies {SmolderingGuardPower:diff()} [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] to its attacker.
ELESIS-DELAY_THE_STRIKE.title: Delay the Strike
ELESIS-DELAY_THE_STRIKE.description: Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [red]Weak[/red]. If the target intends to attack, apply {BurnPower:diff()} [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color].
ELESIS-TACTICAL_WITHDRAWAL.title: Tactical Withdrawal
ELESIS-TACTICAL_WITHDRAWAL.description: Draw {Cards} card. At the next Block cleanup, retain up to {CounterRetentionPower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue].
ELESIS-EVER_READY.title: Ever Ready
ELESIS-EVER_READY.description: At the start of your turn, gain {EverReadyPower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue].
ELESIS-CINDER_ETCHING.title: Cinder Etching
ELESIS-CINDER_ETCHING.description: The first Attack that hits an enemy each turn applies {CinderEtchingPower:diff()} [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color].
ELESIS-TEMPERED_RETORT.title: Tempered Retort
ELESIS-TEMPERED_RETORT.description: The first time each enemy takes Counter Attack damage each enemy turn, apply {TemperedRetortPower:diff()} [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] to it.
ELESIS-AEGIS_TEETH.title: Aegis Teeth
ELESIS-AEGIS_TEETH.description: Whenever a card grants Block, gain {AegisTeethPower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue] once for that card.
ELESIS-ASHEN_SHELTER.title: Ashen Shelter
ELESIS-PUNISHING_RHYTHM.title: Punishing Rhythm
ELESIS-PUNISHING_RHYTHM.description: After the first attack hit you receive each enemy turn, gain {PunishingRhythmPower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue].
ELESIS-DEEP_SCORCH.title: Deep Scorch
ELESIS-DEEP_SCORCH.description: The first time you apply [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] each turn, apply {DeepScorchPower:diff()} additional Burn.
ELESIS-FALLING_EMBERS.title: Falling Embers
ELESIS-FALLING_EMBERS.description: After an enemy's [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] decays, apply {FallingEmbersPower:diff()} Burn to another enemy, or 1 fewer back to it if none remain.
ELESIS-FURNACE_RAMPART.title: Furnace Rampart
ELESIS-FURNACE_RAMPART.description: At the start of the enemy turn, if you have [blue]Counter Attack[/blue], gain {FurnaceRampartPower:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
ELESIS-CRIMSON_REPRISAL.title: Crimson Reprisal
ELESIS-CRIMSON_REPRISAL.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If [blue]Counter Attack[/blue] dealt damage since your last turn, repeat this attack {RepeatCount:diff()} time.
ELESIS-PYRE_DIVIDE.title: Pyre Divide
ELESIS-PYRE_DIVIDE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Trigger all of the target's [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] without reducing it.
ELESIS-PERFECT_ANSWER.title: Perfect Answer
ELESIS-PERFECT_ANSWER.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain [blue]Counter Attack[/blue] equal to half the unblocked damage dealt, up to {CounterCap:diff()}.
ELESIS-SCARLET_CROSSFIRE.title: Scarlet Crossfire
ELESIS-SCARLET_CROSSFIRE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Hits} times. Apply {BurnPower:diff()} [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] after each hit.
ELESIS-SENTENCE_OF_ASH.title: Sentence of Ash
ELESIS-SENTENCE_OF_ASH.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Burned enemies take additional damage equal to their [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color].
ELESIS-MIRRORSTEEL_LUNGE.title: Mirrorsteel Lunge
ELESIS-MIRRORSTEEL_LUNGE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. The next {DoubleCounterPower:diff()} attack hits before your next turn trigger [blue]Counter Attack[/blue] twice.
ELESIS-LASTING_SCAR.title: Lasting Scar
ELESIS-LASTING_SCAR.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] equal to the target's current Burn, up to {BurnCap:diff()}.
ELESIS-RED_HORIZON.title: Red Horizon
ELESIS-RED_HORIZON.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Gain {CounterAttackPower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue]. Apply {BurnPower:diff()} [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] to ALL enemies.
ELESIS-ABSOLUTE_GUARD.title: Absolute Guard
ELESIS-SEALED_DEFENSE.title: Sealed Defense
ELESIS-SEALED_DEFENSE.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Your [blue]Counter Attack[/blue] does not expire at the next Block cleanup.
ELESIS-ASH_CASCADE.title: Ash Cascade
ELESIS-ASH_CASCADE.description: Apply {BurnPower:diff()} [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] to ALL enemies, then deal damage equal to half their Burn without reducing it.
ELESIS-BORROWED_HEAT.title: Borrowed Heat
ELESIS-BORROWED_HEAT.description: Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to an enemy's [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color], up to {BlockCap:diff()}, then remove one {BurnReductionDivisor:diff()}th of its Burn.
ELESIS-RETURN_TO_SENDER.title: Return to Sender
ELESIS-RETURN_TO_SENDER.description: For each hit in the target's intent, up to {HitCap}, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and {CounterAttackPower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue].
ELESIS-BRAND_THE_AGGRESSOR.title: Brand the Aggressor
ELESIS-BRAND_THE_AGGRESSOR.description: Apply {BurnPower:diff()} [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color]. Each attack hit that target deals before your next turn applies {AggressorBrandPower:diff()} more Burn to it.
ELESIS-ENCIRCLED_BULWARK.title: Encircled Bulwark
ELESIS-ENCIRCLED_BULWARK.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and {CounterAttackPower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue], plus {AdditionalEnemyBonus:diff()} of each per additional enemy intending to attack.
ELESIS-REKINDLED_DEFENSE.title: Rekindled Defense
ELESIS-REKINDLED_DEFENSE.description: Remove all [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] from ALL enemies. Gain {BlockPerBurn:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] per Burn removed, up to {BlockCap:diff()}.
ELESIS-READ_EVERY_BLADE.title: Read Every Blade
ELESIS-READ_EVERY_BLADE.description: Draw {Cards} cards. Gain {CounterAttackPower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue] per enemy intending to attack.
ELESIS-UNFADING_GUARD.title: Unfading Guard
ELESIS-UNFADING_GUARD.description: At Block cleanup, lose only {UnfadingGuardPower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue] instead of all of it.
ELESIS-BANKED_INFERNO.title: Banked Inferno
ELESIS-BANKED_INFERNO.description: [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] loses only one {BankedInfernoPower:diff()}th of its amount when it decays, rounded up.
ELESIS-HALL_OF_MIRRORS.title: Hall of Mirrors
ELESIS-HALL_OF_MIRRORS.description: Whenever [blue]Counter Attack[/blue] damages an enemy, all other enemies take {Fraction:diff()}x that damage.
ELESIS-PERSISTENT_BLAZE.title: Persistent Blaze
ELESIS-PERSISTENT_BLAZE.description: At the start of your turn, apply {PersistentBlazePower:diff()} [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] to ALL enemies.
ELESIS-ASHEN_TRIUMPH.title: Ashen Triumph
ELESIS-ASHEN_TRIUMPH.description: The first {AshenTriumphPower:diff()} enemies killed by [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] each turn grant 1 Energy and draw 2 cards.
ELESIS-HEAT_IN_THE_WOUND.title: Heat in the Wound
ELESIS-HEAT_IN_THE_WOUND.description: [blue]Counter Attack[/blue] deals 1 additional damage for every {HeatInTheWoundPower:diff()} [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] on the attacker.
ELESIS-PAIN_INTO_PLATE.title: Pain into Plate
ELESIS-PAIN_INTO_PLATE.description: The first time each enemy turn you take unblocked attack damage, gain that much [gold]Block[/gold], up to {PainIntoPlatePower:diff()}.
ELESIS-AFTERBURN.title: Afterburn
ELESIS-AFTERBURN.description: After a burned enemy finishes an attack, deal damage equal to {Fraction:diff()}x its remaining [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] without reducing it.
ELESIS-PAIRED_RESOLVE.title: Paired Resolve
ELESIS-PAIRED_RESOLVE.description: Whenever a card applies [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color], gain {PairedResolvePower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue] once for that card.
ELESIS-RED_ECLIPSE.title: Red Eclipse
ELESIS-RED_ECLIPSE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Trigger each enemy's [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color] without reducing it. Gain {CounterAttackPower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue] per enemy damaged.
ELESIS-BELDERS_LAST_STAND.title: Belder's Last Stand
ELESIS-BELDERS_LAST_STAND.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and {CounterAttackPower:diff()} [blue]Counter Attack[/blue]. Double each enemy's [color=#ff8a1f]Burn[/color], adding at most {BurnCap:diff()} per enemy.
